# Copilot Instructions for Classmate Unity C# Code Inspection Workspace

- This workspace is for trusted inspection of Unity C# code from classmates.
- Use recommended extensions for C# and Unity code analysis.
- Place code to be inspected in subfolders.
- Document findings and feedback in markdown files or comments.
- Workspace trust is enabled for full feature support.

Refer to the README.md for more details and workflow.
